text:
sara: Quick sync — need to reconcile MDF ledger ahead of QBR. SI credits vs committed HW credits look off, some partners show double-applied credits. Anyone have the latest ledger export?
aj_finops: I pulled a diff, looks like ~30% of MDF earmarked for SI didn't get applied to partner tiers in HubSpot. Uploading CSV now.
mike_pm: drop into /shared/partnerships please — QBR deck is due Friday.
elen_partners: quick question — do we count marketplace co-fund as MDF for tier math or no? cc @aj_finops
sara: We agreed co-fund counts but only if contract signed before the QBR cutoff. Filter should be signed_date <= 2025-01-01.
aj_finops: running `jq -r '.entries[] | select(.signed_date <= "2025-01-01" and .fund_type=="cofund")' partners-ledger.json` — will post sample rows.
ci-bot: Upload complete: partners-ledger-175432.csv (100KB) :white_check_mark:
mike_pm: thx. Also — SI integration credits that rolled on 11/12 — are those one-time or recurring?
elen_partners: per legal note those were one-time implementation credits, not recurring.
sara: Actions:
- aj_finops: produce reconciled ledger with tier flags by EOD (5pm PT)
- elen_partners: confirm contract flags + attach relevant clause
- mike_pm: update QBR slide with adjusted tier counts / proposed messaging
If we undercount tiers, propose temporary 'grace' bucket to avoid partner churn.
aj_finops: :thumbsup: on it, aiming for 5pm PT.
mike_pm: I'll draft the grace language — propose: "temporary tier grace for partners with signed contracts pending marketplace onboarding" — thoughts?
elen_partners: that wording works, I'll add a line about eligibility window and exceptions.
sara: Great — adding this to the QBR agenda. Ping here if anything blocks. Thanks all :rocket:
